card.title: Protection Through Silence
card.instruction: Protect others by withholding details, redirecting questions, and managing timing because you trust your own judgment about when the truth should surface.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give you the landlord's letter once you're sitting down. You've only just got home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's addressed to me. Is he selling our flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's get you out of this doorway before we discuss where we'll live.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's your favourite chair. Come to the kitchen; I'd rather you didn't remember this whenever you sit there.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 withholds the landlord letter until A deems B settled, A3 redirects the direct question to location, and A5 changes the required seat to protect future associations.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's sale question causes A3's move-from-doorway instruction; B4's compliance causes A5's finer control over where the truth can be received.

relationship.evidence: B2 claims an addressed letter and asks its meaning; B4 complies with the stated seating condition.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's sitting down to identify a new emotional consequence and redirect the disclosure site.
